title: Satellites Don't Fall Because of This Shocking Truth
hook: Satellites are always falling. Here's why.
script: Satellites are constantly falling back to Earth, even though they seem to float effortlessly. It's true! They're actually in a perpetual state of freefall, just like if you jumped off a high diving board. The secret? Rockets launch them so incredibly fast – thousands of miles per hour sideways – that as they fall, the Earth curves away beneath them. They keep falling *around* the planet instead of *into* it. This constant 'missing' the ground is what we call orbit. So, every satellite above us is just continuously falling, never quite hitting the surface of Earth, which means satellites are constantly falling back to Earth, even though they seem to float effortlessly.
